collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager wants Turtle Rock renamed after themselves: keep at it, or settle for half.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There's a big rock on the beach shaped a little like a sleeping turtle, and everyone calls it Turtle Rock. (name1) has decided that, since (he/she) sits on it more than anybody else, it ought to be called (name1)'s Rock. (He/she) has started calling it that in conversation, often, in the hope that it will catch on.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Meet you at (name1)'s Rock." "Lovely sunset from (name1)'s Rock tonight." (name1) never misses a chance. Slowly, one or two children start to use it. Then the rest of the village. A season later it's (name1)'s Rock to everyone, except the turtles, who carry on sleeping on it regardless.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: After a week of everyone saying "You mean Turtle Rock?", (name1) offers a compromise: "(name1)'s Turtle Rock." Nobody uses it except (name1). (He/she) goes on using it, with great dignity, for years.
